name: node-tao
description: Lightweight, fast, and powerful embedded JS template engine
author: Manu Claeys <unam31@gmail.com>

scripts.build: rimraf dist && tsc && cpx src/public/**/* dist/public && cpx "src/templates/**/*" dist/templates
scripts.startNodemon: nodemon --ext ts,js,json,css,html --watch src --exec "tsc && cpx src/templates/**/* dist/templates && cpx src/error/**/* dist/error && node dist/server.js"
